column1: # Lalivero interiors: the report to Faran and the search for Sheba.
# First account of the search and the fate of Idejima.

column3: We were{pause_20_skippable} unable to\nfind any sign of her.{end_wait}
The sea is too rough\nfor us to search.{end_wait}
And on land, there is\nno trace of her...{end_wait}
Tolbi is responsible\nfor what happened to\n{actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
No apology can lessen\nthe grief I feel for\nyour loss, Faran...{end_wait}
All we can do for\n{actor_name:7} now is...\nhope.{end_wait}
But tell me, what of\n{actor_name:6} and the\nothers?{end_wait}
The same. We searched\neverywhere, but found\nno sign of them.{end_wait}
The lighthouse's shock\ntore the ground apart,\nand the ship...{end_wait}
Everything at Idejima,\nship included, was\nswept out to sea...{end_wait}
So Idejima itself\nwas washed out to sea?{end_now}
Incredible... Then the\ncave must have flooded\nas well?{end_wait}
But we believe {actor_name:6}\nand the others are\nstill alive.{end_wait}
They may have been\ncarried out to sea\nwith Idejima.{end_wait}
We will keep searching\nuntil we find {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
Haven't we,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}

column1: # Faran's response, the Adept discussion, and the farewell.

column3: You need not worry\nabout {actor_name:7}...{end_wait}
We will find {actor_name:7}\nwithout fail...{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} has faced\ndanger before and\nsurvived.{end_wait}
But this time...\nIt would take a miracle.{end_wait}
Who could have guessed\nthe sea would rise as\nshe fell?{end_wait}
Can you truly call\nthat a miracle?{end_wait}
Was it really a miracle,\nor simply good fortune?{end_wait}
Call it coincidence,\nfor now.{end_wait}
Nothing is coincidence\nwhen it comes to this\nchild.{end_wait}
So you believe\n{actor_name:7} survived...?{end_wait}
Yes. I am certain.{end_wait}
Because {actor_name:7}...\nwas an Adept?{end_wait}
An Adept...?\nWhat is that?{end_wait}
Well, it's...{end_wait}
Someone with abilities\nlike theirs.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, you and your\nfriends are remarkable.{end_wait}
You entered the ancient\nruins and reached\nVenus Lighthouse.{end_wait}
But {actor_name:7} was different.\nShe could not enter\nthe ruins.{end_wait}
That's because {actor_name:7}'s\nabilities differ from\ntheirs.{end_wait}
I have explained this\nto Faran again and again.\nHe still will not listen!{end_wait}
{actor_name:2}, that is\nunfair...{end_wait}
We cannot stay here.\nWe have to go.{end_wait}
Of course. I did not\nmean to keep you...{end_wait}
That did not come\nout as I intended...{end_wait}
While we speak,\n{actor_name:6} and the others\nare still lost at sea.{end_wait}
I understand. You cannot\nafford to wait.{end_wait}
The sea has been rough\nsince the beacon was lit.\nBe careful!{end_wait}
You, too. Farewell.{end_wait}
Take care...\nand farewell!{end_wait}
Thank you. I hope your\nsearch for {actor_name:7}\nends in success.{end_wait}

column1: # Alternate report when the party did not see the ship at Idejima.

column3: The same. We searched\neverywhere, but found\nno sign of them.{end_wait}
The shock from the\nlighthouse tore the\nground apart...{end_wait}
Then Idejima itself\nwas swept out to sea...{end_wait}
My goodness... Then\n{actor_name:6} and the others\nmust have...{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} said he sent\n{actor_name:6} ahead to the\nship from the lighthouse.{end_wait}
But we believe they\nsurvived.{end_wait}
They may have been\ncarried out to sea\nwith Idejima...{end_wait}
We will keep searching\nfor {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
Isn't that right,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}
You will find {actor_name:6}.\nI believe that...\nFarewell.{end_wait}
